shots.prompt: High-angle close-up of a pizzaiolo's hands giving the final shape to a round Neapolitan pizza base on a floured white marble counter. The base is already stretched: the hands turn it a little with each move and gently press and even out the puffy rim with the fingertips, so the edge becomes perfectly round and even. The dough is soft, supple and slightly translucent in the light. Slow, subtle push-in.
shots.details: Real details: a light dusting of flour drifting in the warm light.

shots.prompt: Three-quarter high-angle close-up. A stainless steel ladle pours thick, glossy red tomato sauce onto the centre of the round pizza base on the floured marble counter, then the back of the ladle spreads the sauce outward in slow, steady circles, leaving a clean rim of dough. The sauce is rich and catches the warm light. Slow, steady camera.
shots.details: Real details: glossy sauce, fine flour dust on the marble.
shots.note: Made in daylight; «night» turns it dark with a golden spotlight when the film is built (the lights go out after the dough).

shots.prompt: The same three-quarter close-up in the dark, a single warm golden spotlight on the pizza. The ladle lifts out of frame, and a pizzaiolo's hands place torn pieces of fresh white mozzarella one by one onto the red tomato sauce; the soft, milky cheese stretches into strands as it is pulled apart, glistening gold in the light. Slow, steady camera.
shots.details: Real details: cheese stretching into milky strands, glossy sauce catching golden highlights.

shots.prompt: Inside a wood-fired oven, low close-up at the level of the oven floor. The pizza bakes: the mozzarella melts, bubbles and spreads into the red sauce, the already charred crust puffs up a little more, and the flames flicker and roll over the burning logs behind it. Locked-off camera with a gentle time-lapse feel.
